result.reason: The revision reaches the preferred position by eliminating the Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal option, requiring mutual written agreement, and capping renewal increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. It preserves the unrelated termination provisions. However, it is not minimal or fully polished: imposing successive 12-month terms is unnecessary under the mutual-agreement option, and subsections II and III remain duplicative and contain the defective phrase “mutual written of the parties” and an ambiguous 45-day timing requirement.
